newsitem.title: PERU: Peru says to auction Talara refinery in February.
newsitem.headline: Peru says to auction Talara refinery in February.

text.p: State oil company Petroperu planned to auction the country's second largest refinery, Talara, in February, a Peruvian privatization official said Tuesday.

The Talara refinery, situated in the department of Piura, 655 miles (1050 km) north of Lima, had a capacity to produce 62,000 barrels a day of refined oil, said Guillermo Seminario, government spokesman for the privatization of oil assets.
A minimum price bid for the asset would be set in the first half of February and the sale would go ahead in the second half of that month, Seminario added.
The refinery auction is part of Pertroperu's piecemeal privatization.
In June, a consortium led by Spain's Repsol SA bought a 60 percent stake in the country's largest refinery, La Pampilla, for $180.5 million.
The government has also auctioned its lubricants unit, Petrolube, and the rights to explore and exploit several oil blocks.
